001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import gnu.trove.iterator.TIntIterator;
004import gnu.trove.list.TIntList;
005import gnu.trove.list.array.TIntArrayList;
006import gnu.trove.map.TIntObjectMap;
007import gnu.trove.map.hash.TIntObjectHashMap;
008import gnu.trove.set.TIntSet;
009import gnu.trove.set.hash.TIntHashSet;
010import java.util.ArrayList;
011import java.util.Arrays;
012import java.util.List;
013import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
014import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
015import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
016import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
017import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
018import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
019import org.clafer.collection.Counter;
020
021/**
022 *
023 * @author jimmy
024 */
025public class PropAtMostTransitiveClosure extends Propagator<SetVar> {
026
027    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
028
029    private final SetVar[] relation;
030    private final SetVar[] closure;
031    private final boolean reflexive;
032
033    public PropAtMostTransitiveClosure(SetVar[] relation, SetVar[] closure, boolean reflexive) {
034        super(buildArray(relation, closure), PropagatorPriority.CUBIC, false);
035        this.relation = relation;
036        this.closure = closure;
037        this.reflexive = reflexive;
038    }
039
040    private static SetVar[] buildArray(SetVar[] relation, SetVar[] closure) {
041        SetVar[] array = new SetVar[relation.length + closure.length];
042        System.arraycopy(relation, 0, array, 0, relation.length);
043        System.arraycopy(closure, 0, array, relation.length, closure.length);
044        return array;
045    }
046
047    @Override
048    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
049        for (SetVar var : relation) {
050            ISetIterator iter = var.getUB().iterator();
051            while(iter.hasNext()) {
052                int i = iter.nextInt();
053                if (i < 0 || i >= relation.length) {
054                    var.remove(i, this);
055                }
056            }
057        }
058
059        TIntSet[] maximalClosure = maximalTransitiveClosure(relation);
060
061        for (int i = 0; i < closure.length; i++) {
062            SetVar var = closure[i];
063            TIntSet reachable = maximalClosure[i];
064            ISetIterator iter = var.getUB().iterator();
065            while(iter.hasNext()) {
066                int k = iter.nextInt();
067                if ((!reflexive || i != k) && !reachable.contains(k)) {
068                    var.remove(k, this);
069                }
070            }
071        }
072    }
073
074    @Override
075    public ESat isEntailed() {
076        for (SetVar var : relation) {
077            ISetIterator iter = var.getLB().iterator();
078            while(iter.hasNext()) {
079                int i = iter.nextInt();
080                if (i < 0 || i >= relation.length) {
081                    return ESat.FALSE;
082                }
083            }
084        }
085
086        TIntSet[] maximalClosure = maximalTransitiveClosure(relation);
087
088        for (int i = 0; i < closure.length; i++) {
089            SetVar var = closure[i];
090            TIntSet reachable = maximalClosure[i];
091            ISetIterator iter = var.getLB().iterator();
092            while(iter.hasNext()) {
093                int k = iter.nextInt();
094                if ((!reflexive || i != k) && !reachable.contains(k)) {
095                    return ESat.FALSE;
096                }
097            }
098        }
099
100        return isCompletelyInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
101    }
102
103    @Override
104    public String toString() {
105        return "atMostTransitiveClosure(" + Arrays.toString(relation) + ", " + Arrays.toString(closure) + ")";
106    }
107
108    private static TIntSet[] maximalTransitiveClosure(SetVar[] relation) {
109        List<TIntSet> components = computeStronglyConnectedComponents(relation);
110        TIntSet[] maximalClosure = new TIntSet[relation.length];
111
112        for (TIntSet component : components) {
113            TIntSet reachable = new TIntHashSet(relation.length);
114
115            TIntIterator iter = component.iterator();
116            while (iter.hasNext()) {
117                int val = iter.next();
118                SetVar var = relation[val];
119                assert maximalClosure[val] == null;
120                maximalClosure[val] = reachable;
121                ISetIterator varIter= var.getUB().iterator();
122                while(varIter.hasNext()) {
123                    int i = varIter.nextInt();
124                    if (i >= 0 && i < relation.length) {
125                        reachable.add(i);
126                        TIntSet reach = maximalClosure[i];
127                        if (reach != null) {
128                            reachable.addAll(reach);
129                        }
130                    }
131                }
132            }
133        }
134        return maximalClosure;
135    }
136
137    private static List<TIntSet> computeStronglyConnectedComponents(SetVar[] relation) {
138        Counter counter = new Counter();
139        TIntObjectMap<Index> vertexIndices = new TIntObjectHashMap<>(relation.length);
140        TIntList S = new TIntArrayList();
141        List<TIntSet> components = new ArrayList<>();
142
143        for (int vertex = 0; vertex < relation.length; vertex++) {
144            if (!vertexIndices.containsKey(vertex)) {
145                strongConnect(relation, vertex, counter, vertexIndices, S, components);
146            }
147        }
148        return components;
149    }
150
151    private static Index strongConnect(SetVar[] relation, int vertex, Counter counter,
152            TIntObjectMap<Index> vertexIndices, TIntList S, List<TIntSet> components) {
153        int index = counter.next();
154        Index vertexIndex = new Index(index, index);
155        vertexIndices.put(vertex, vertexIndex);
156
157        S.add(vertex);
158
159        SetVar var = relation[vertex];
160        ISetIterator iter = var.getUB().iterator();
161        while(iter.hasNext()) {
162            int neighbour = iter.nextInt();
163            if (neighbour >= 0 && neighbour < relation.length) {
164                Index neighbourIndex = vertexIndices.get(neighbour);
165                if (neighbourIndex == null) {
166                    neighbourIndex = strongConnect(relation, neighbour, counter, vertexIndices, S, components);
167                    vertexIndex.setLowIndexMin(neighbourIndex.getLowIndex());
168                } else if (S.contains(neighbour)) {
169                    vertexIndex.setLowIndexMin(neighbourIndex.getIndex());
170                }
171            }
172        }
173
174        if (vertexIndex.getLowIndex() == vertexIndex.getIndex()) {
175            TIntSet component = new TIntHashSet();
176
177            int cycle;
178            do {
179                cycle = S.removeAt(S.size() - 1);
180                component.add(cycle);
181            } while (cycle != vertex);
182
183            components.add(component);
184        }
185        return vertexIndex;
186    }
187
188    private static class Index {
189
190        private final int index;
191        private int lowIndex;
192
193        Index(int index, int lowIndex) {
194            this.index = index;
195            this.lowIndex = lowIndex;
196        }
197
198        int getIndex() {
199            return index;
200        }
201
202        int getLowIndex() {
203            return lowIndex;
204        }
205
206        void setLowIndexMin(int lowIndex) {
207            if (this.lowIndex >= lowIndex) {
208                this.lowIndex = lowIndex;
209            }
210        }
211    }
212}
